title: Image and Behavior Analysis in C6 Glioma Model
author: Souza TKF
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p4hdqt6

steps.title: Weigh and anesthetize animals
steps.instruction: Weigh each rat, then inject intraperitoneally ketamine (100 mg/kg) and xylazine (20 mg/kg); place the animal in a stereotaxic apparatus.

steps.title: Prepare C6 cell suspension
steps.instruction: Dilute C6 glioma cells to a concentration of 1 × 10⁶ cells per 30 mL of culture medium.

steps.title: Stereotaxic injection of cells
steps.instruction: Using the stereotaxic coordinates 2.0 mm anteroposterior, 2.0 mm laterolateral, and 2.5 mm depth, slowly inject the cell suspension (or culture medium for controls) over a 10‑minute period.

steps.title: Close surgical site
steps.instruction: Reassemble the bone with bone wax and suture the skin using cotton thread.

steps.title: Acquire longitudinal MRI scans
steps.instruction: At baseline and on days 7, 14, 21, and 28 post‑surgery, acquire T2‑weighted images using a rapid acquisition with relaxation enhancement (RARE) sequence; calculate total tumor volume as the sum of tumor area in each slice multiplied by slice thickness and inter‑slice gap.

steps.title: In‑vivo bioluminescence imaging
steps.instruction: Anesthetize rats with isoflurane, inject D‑Luciferin intraperitoneally at 450 mg/kg 10 minutes before imaging, then acquire bioluminescence images with an IVIS system.

steps.title: Ex‑vivo BLI and histology
steps.instruction: After in‑vivo BLI, euthanize one animal per group, excise the brain, perform ex‑vivo bioluminescence imaging, and subsequently process the tissue for histological assessment.

steps.title: Measure spontaneous locomotor activity
steps.instruction: Place each rat in the center of an infrared (IR) Actimeter (square arena 450 × 450 mm², walls 30 cm high) and record movement for 5 minutes; quantify slow movements (S‑MOV), fast movements (F‑MOV), slow stereotyped (S‑STE), fast stereotyped (F‑STE), slow rearing (S‑REA), and fast rearing (F‑REA).

steps.title: Analyze gait with Catwalk
steps.instruction: Allow the rat to traverse the 1.3‑m glass Catwalk platform (Noldus Information Technology, Netherlands) illuminated by downward fluorescent light; automatically classify each paw print as right forepaw (RF), right hindpaw (RH), left forepaw (LF), or left hindpaw (LH).

substeps.instruction: Extract spatial parameters: print positions (PP), base of support (BOS), stride length (SL), and maximum contact area (mCA).
Extract temporal parameters: stand duration, step cycle (SC), cadence (steps / second), and total run duration.
